extension.description:
Cybersalt Userback Admin

Injects the Userback feedback widget into your Joomla site for easy bug reporting, screenshots, and feedback collection.

Features:

  • Display widget in Administrator backend
  • Display widget on Frontend for logged-in users
  • Detect backend sessions on frontend (show to admins browsing the site)
  • User group restrictions for both backend and frontend
  • Optional guest access on frontend
  • Prevents enabling without a valid access token

Credits: Developed by Cybersalt Consulting Ltd. with contributions from Gurnoor Deol.

View on GitHub

field.name: embed_mode
field.label: Embed Mode
field.description: How to configure the Userback widget. Access Token (recommended): the plugin builds the loader from just your token. Full Script: paste the entire embed snippet from your Userback dashboard — use this if Userback updates their loader before this plugin does. In both modes, the plugin still injects user identification, page context, category, and screenshot settings automatically.

field.name: access_token
field.label: Userback Access Token
field.description: Enter your Userback project access token (e.g. P-a2HiX6xFzcD2LOHaPHMLlCcDV).

field.name: custom_script
field.label: Userback Embed Script
field.description: Paste the full Userback embed script from your dashboard here.

field.name: native_screenshot
field.label: Native Screenshot
field.description: Use the browser's native Screen Capture API instead of Userback's server-side renderer. Auto enables native on localhost, *.local, *.test, and hostnames containing 'staging'/'dev'. Use Yes if feedback is arriving without screenshots on a private or auth-gated site.

field.name: enable_backend
field.label: Enable in Backend
field.description: Show the Userback widget in the administrator area.

field.name: backend_usergroups
field.label: Backend User Groups
field.description: Select which user groups can see the widget in the backend. Leave empty to show to all backend users.

field.name: category_backend
field.label: Backend Category
field.description: Pre-selected Userback category for feedback submitted from the administrator area. Helps with dashboard routing.

field.name: enable_frontend
field.label: Enable on Frontend
field.description: Show the Userback widget on the public site.

field.name: frontend_usergroups
field.label: Frontend User Groups
field.description: Select which user groups can see the widget on the frontend. Leave empty to show to all logged-in users.

field.name: show_guests
field.label: Show to Guests
field.description: Show the Userback widget to non-logged-in visitors.

field.name: category_frontend
field.label: Frontend Category
field.description: Pre-selected Userback category for feedback submitted from the public site. Helps with dashboard routing.
